note: TASKS.md P1-1d. Element-wise median of three matchers' consensus corner fields over flir val (1,013 pairs, identity warp). Legs sit 0.21 (eloftr) / 1.16 (splg) / 2.33 (roma) px from it. Transcribed from the published table because the source Parquet is on the training server; scripts/p3b_calibrate.py re-derives it there as a check. Composing removes ~9.5 px and injects ~1.2 px of matcher-choice bias, against the ~4.1 px per-pair scatter that no calibration can remove.
